title: Normalized chain representative for direct image
statement: Let h:X→Y be a morphism of schemes and E an object of the derived category of modules on X. For the fixed K-injective resolutions I of E and J of Rh_*E from [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], there exists a chain map f:h_*I→J with phi_I.hom ≫ Q(f) ≫ resolutionIso_J.hom = Rh_*(resolutionIso_I.hom). No K-injectivity of h_*I is assumed. Here phi_I:Rh_*(QI)≅Q(h_*I) is the canonical K-injective direct-image computation isomorphism, and resolutionIso_I:QI≅E and resolutionIso_J:QJ≅Rh_*E are the fixed resolution isomorphisms.

proof.text: Compose phi_I.inv, Rh_*(resolutionIso_I.hom), and resolutionIso_J.inv to obtain a morphism Q(h_*I)→QJ. By [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived] represent it in the homotopy category, because J is K-injective. Fullness of the homotopy quotient gives a chain map. Naturality of quotientCompQhIso identifies its localization with the desired morphism; cancel the two isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeMV_normalized_chain_map_exists
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] :
    ∃ f : ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj (schemeMVResolution X E) ⟶
        schemeMVResolution Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E),
      (RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso h.toLRSHom.toShHom
        (schemeMVResolution X E)).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f ≫
        (schemeMVResolutionIso Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E)).hom =
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map (schemeMVResolutionIso X E).hom
